_comment: Physical device (phone/tablet) on the same Wi-Fi as the dev machine. Copy to config/lan.json and replace 192.168.1.20 with your machine's LAN IP (macOS: `ipconfig getifaddr en0`). The backend already allows LAN origins via CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS in infra/.env — keep that in sync with your IP. Run: flutter run -d chrome --web-hostname 0.0.0.0 --dart-define-from-file=config/lan.json
